name: prairielearn-navigator
description: provides definitions and inlay hints for prairielearn assessments and questions

prairielearn-navigator.plVersion.patternErrorMessage: Use "latest", a date (YYYY-MM-DD), or a 40-character commit sha.
prairielearn-navigator.plVersion.markdownDescription: PrairieLearn version to validate course JSON against: `latest`, a date (`YYYY-MM-DD`, the state of PrairieLearn's `master` that day), or a commit sha. Set in `.vscode/settings.json` to override the course's `.pl-navigator.jsonc`.

prairielearn-navigator.schemaCacheDir.markdownDescription: Directory for downloaded PrairieLearn schemas, relative to the workspace folder. Empty uses the extension's global storage.

prairielearn-navigator.uuidCommand.markdownDescription: Shell command used to generate UUID completion values. The command must print one UUID to standard output.

prairielearn-navigator.missingQuestionIn.markdownDescription: Severity of the diagnostic for a directory in `questions/` with files but no `info.json` (and no question below it), which PrairieLearn fails to load from disk. Shown on the directory's `question.html`, or else its first file. Set in `.vscode/settings.json` to override the course's `.pl-navigator.jsonc`.

prairielearn-navigator.excludes.markdownDescription: Glob patterns of files never to check, relative to the workspace folder, e.g. `courseInstances/Archive/**`. Added to the course's `.pl-navigator.jsonc` `excludes`.
